d:
CM Hemant Soren se milne ko tarse madhyamik aachary abhyarthi, niyukti ka intjar kab hoga khatm?
Jharkhand men madhyamik aachary ke abhyarthi niyukti ko lekar pareshan hain. janavri men pariksha huee aur maee men rijalt bhi jari kar diya gaya, lekin ab tak niyukti prakriya puri nahin ho saki hai. abhyarthi mukhyamantri hemant soren se milne ki koshish kar rahe hain, lekin unhen mulakat ka samay nahin mil pa raha hai.
